summary: Iter 92.58 GODMODE frontend validation — Simulation Briefing wizard + Chat follow-up chips + Task opt-in + design polish. All 5 requested feature groups PASS end-to-end on Chromium 1920x900 as accelerator@wladbot.test.

test_execution_evidence.simulation_briefing_wizard: GO: 12 scenarios rendered. Clicking scenario-feedback-session opened simulation-briefing modal (NOT auto-start). simulation-input was NOT present before briefing completion (confirmed gating). briefing-start-btn was DISABLED initially, still disabled after picking only counterpart (1 selection), and only ENABLED after both counterpart+goal selected. All 3 counterpart chips (emotional/rational/dominant) and all 3 goal chips (klarheit/empathie/ergebnis) rendered with data-testid. Close via X (briefing-close) removed the modal. Backdrop click (mouse at modal outer bounds) also closed the modal. After selecting emotional+empathie and clicking briefing-start-btn, simulation-input became visible within timeout (AI intro loaded, briefing modal dismissed, end-simulation-btn visible in header).
test_execution_evidence.chat_followup_chips: GO: Sent 'Mein Team ist demotiviert, was tun? Bitte gib mir konkrete Schritte.' Assistant returned full parsed JSON with insight+strategy+action_steps(3)+reflection+tasks+follow_up_questions. Final screenshot confirms 2 chat-followup-* chips rendered under the latest AI message: 'Wie formuliere ich mein Feedback effektiv?' and 'Welche Anreize kann ich für das Team schaffen?'. Note: an initial poll returned chips=null because ChatPage only wires onSuggest when !loading — chips render slightly after streaming completes. This is intentional design, not a bug. Chips only render on the latest message (onSuggest conditional).
test_execution_evidence.chat_task_optin: GO: chat-tasks-suggestion card rendered with 'Vorschlag: Aufgaben' header and 'Als Aufgaben übernehmen' button (chat-tasks-accept-btn). Clicking accept triggered POST /api/chat/tasks/accept and card swapped to chat-tasks-created showing '1 Aufgabe(n) erstellt' with green check. No auto-creation on AI response (opt-in confirmed).
test_execution_evidence.chat_design_polish: GO: input placeholder='Frag WladBot alles über Leadership…' (exact match). Send button computed background = rgb(191, 255, 0) = #BFFF00 lime. Input focus box-shadow includes 'rgba(191, 255, 0, 0.4) 0px 0px 0px 2px' lime ring; border color rgba(191, 255, 0, 0.5) on focus.
test_execution_evidence.regression_simulation_end: GO: After starting simulation with counterpart+goal, sent user message, clicked end-simulation-btn ('JETZT BEENDEN & BEWERTEN'). simulation-scores view rendered within timeout with Empathie=78, Leadership=52, Klarheit=58, Gesamt=60 and full KI-Feedback text.
test_execution_evidence.regression_chat_cards: GO: assistant JSON parsed correctly — Leadership-Erkenntnis, Strategie, Nächste Schritte (numbered 1-3), reflection italic card, and follow-up chips all render in order per ChatMessage.js.

critical_code_review_comments: MINOR (not blocking): Follow-up chips only wire onSuggest for latest message with !loading, which creates a brief window (during streaming) where chips are invisible even though parsed.follow_up_questions is present in the JSON. Consider rendering chips as disabled during loading for smoother perceived transition. Not user-facing critical.
MINOR (a11y): briefing-close X button uses aria-label='close'; consider translating to 'schließen' when de=true to match rest of German UI.
MINOR: SimulationBriefing backdrop closes on any outer div click — good — but no ESC key handler. Consider adding key listener for full modal parity.

INFO: ChatMessage.js FollowUpChips uses `key={fu-${i}}` which is fine but if a follow-up question text changes on re-render (e.g., during typewriter), React might reuse stale nodes. Consider keying on question text hash. Not observed in test.
test_credentials: accelerator@wladbot.test / test123 (used successfully, unlimited credits confirmed)
seed_data_creation: 1 task created via POST /api/chat/tasks/accept during test (side effect, not seeded).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 92.58 fully green. Key gotchas for future testing: (1) onSuggest for chat-followup-chips is only bound when !loading, so wait for assistant to finish streaming (poll for chat-followup-chips selector or add ~5-8s buffer after chat-ai-message appears) before asserting chips. (2) Simulation briefing X button close AND backdrop click both work — modal is properly gated so simulation-input never renders before briefing-start-btn is pressed. (3) LLM sometimes returns tasks in the parsed JSON and sometimes doesn't — the test session for accelerator user reliably returned tasks for 'Mein Team ist demotiviert' prompt. (4) simulation-scores endpoint returns real scores from LLM within 15-30s after end-simulation-btn.
